memory_candidates.content: A phase's Verification Tier is a function of a MEASURED file list, not an asserted one. In the BimodalLogic tree a superseded-name sweep that both the task dispatch and the research report scoped to a single markdown file measured, at plan time, eight markdown files and zero .lean files -- the zero .lean result is what licensed the cheap 'prose' tier and kept the change off the one-full-rebuild budget. The reusable pattern: when a plan assigns a tier below 'full' on the strength of an edit class (comments-only, markdown-only), the phase's Scope Hypothesis must state the tier-ESCALATION TRIGGER explicitly -- 'if any .lean file turns up in the re-measurement, the tier rises to at least local and the rebuild budget must be re-examined' -- so the implementer cannot silently inherit a cheap tier under a widened file set. Re-run the sweep grep before editing; the file list is usually the least trustworthy number in a plan.
